mapper.select: SELECT id, public_id, vehicle_id, created_at FROM trip WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip (public_id, vehicle_id, status, car_consented_at, created_at, last_activity_at) VALUES (#{publicId}, #{vehicleId}, 'ACTIVE', #{now}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE trip SET status = #{status}, ended_at = #{now}, dest_name = NULL, dest_lat = NULL, dest_lng = NULL, last_lat = NULL, last_lng = NULL, last_heading = NULL, last_reported_at = NULL, energy_type = NULL, energy_pct = NULL, range_m = NULL WHERE id = #{tripId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND last_activity_at < #{idleBefore}
UPDATE trip SET last_activity_at = #{now} WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO trip_passenger (trip_id, passenger_id, joined_at, consented_at) VALUES (#{tripId}, #{passengerId}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE trip SET last_lat = #{lat}, last_lng = #{lng}, last_heading = #{heading}, last_reported_at = #{now} WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE trip SET energy_type = #{energyType}, energy_pct = #{energyPct}, range_m = #{rangeM} WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE trip SET dest_name = #{name}, dest_lat = #{lat}, dest_lng = #{lng} WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT last_lat AS lat, last_lng AS lng FROM trip WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND last_lat IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO waypoint_request (trip_id, passenger_id, place_type, place_ext_id, poi_name, address, lat, lng, action, status, requested_at) VALUES (#{tripId}, #{passengerId}, #{placeType}, #{extId}, #{name}, #{address}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{action}, 'PENDING', #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM waypoint_request WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND status = 'PENDING'

SELECT wr.id, t.vehicle_id, wr.place_type, wr.place_ext_id, wr.poi_name, wr.address, wr.lat, wr.lng, wr.action, wr.status, wr.requested_at, wr.fail_reason, p.nickname AS requested_by FROM waypoint_request wr JOIN trip t ON t.id = wr.trip_id JOIN passenger p ON p.id = wr.passenger_id WHERE wr.id = #{requestId}
SELECT dest_name FROM trip WHERE id = #{tripId}
SELECT wr.place_ext_id FROM waypoint_request wr JOIN trip t ON t.id = wr.trip_id WHERE wr.id = #{requestId} AND t.vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND wr.place_type = 'REST_AREA'
